description: Turns the reference's motion-spec.json into a starter project for a renderer: `hyperframes` (index.html + one scene per shot with GSAP eases), `remotion` (Sequences per shot with Easing.bezier), `css` (tokens, keyframes and a preview page), `after-effects` (framelens-reference.jsx: run it in After Effects to build the comp with eased keyframes and cut/beat markers), `lottie` (reference.json with solids, placeholder shapes and bezier easing) or `hypit` (references/<slug>/ANALYSIS.md, TIMELINE.md and transcript.json plus HANDOFF.md for the Hypit video tool, filled from the workspace notes). It carries structure, cut times, colours and move timing; replace the placeholders with the user's own content. Runs `style` first when needed. Afterwards render it and check it with `compare`.

source.description: The video: a link (YouTube and other sites), a path to a local file, or `inbox` for the newest file in the inbox folder.

name: export
title: Starter project from the reference
